export_scope: Separate portable archive contains final globally corrected selected/ablation AIG pairs, DSEC logs/metadata and six input/loaded graphs, but not all raw SAT/model logs.
independent_review_scope: All comparisons use this one new current-runtime three-arm run; historical missing raw outputs were not spliced or recreated.
Saved solver/DSEC statuses are authenticated and SAT/model assignments independently replayed; reviewer performed no new solving or DRAT re-proof.
Only selected-root bounded Direct plus whole-original structural aliases were audited; native novelty and unrestricted Boolean Direct exhaustion are not established.
Three cache arms timed out; their valid on-time incumbents are retained without claiming completed search or successful final all-created cache closure.
Costs are separate measurements of their stated boundaries; audit work is outside each120s transform, and no precise cause of the area difference is assigned.
inference_boundary: One preregistered rotated observation per case/arm under120s. Cache recovers some uncached-free losses; cached predecessor-free remains below current inline baseline. No broad gain, native novelty, or cross-recovery historical timing claim.
memory_limitations: 100ms requested sampling plus observer overhead; sums shared pages; short-lived peaks may be missed. Cached b20 remains null due to multiple worker identities. This is not exact peak memory.
packet_compaction: Long retained/qualified identity-delta lists are represented by counts and the hash-bound immutable summary.json; selected identities, exact graph/DSEC/source bindings and all18 summaries remain included.

plan_scope.audit_policy: all18 arms freshly invoke repaired auditor without --reuse-audit and fresh whole-original alias classification; only exact same-run graph-bound DSEC reuse; no historical baseline

disk_policy.checks: before every transform and audit; fail closed and skip remaining jobs on capacity failure
disk_policy.growth_observation: before/after filesystem free-space delta, including current partial job consumption; not process-attributed writes
disk_policy.limitation: 12GiB is a planning allowance, not a measured output bound. Historic exact per-arm sizes unavailable after shared storage loss. Pre-stage checks do not impose a within-process write quota.

plan_scope.environment_recovery: Shared storage was lost; this is a fresh scratch-only plan with re-bound tools and surviving committed inputs. Historical raw outputs remain unavailable references. All18 arms run in this current environment; no cross-recovery historical timing contrast.
plan_scope.order_policy: three cyclic arm orders, then their reversals; every arm occupies each position twice and each pair order is balanced
plan_scope.validator: FULL compiled original-model validation in all arms

timeout_boundary: Only on-time admitted checkpoints count as products. Discovery/funnel progress may be later than the admitted proof prefix; success-final cache reports are absent after timeout.
timing_limitations: All arms share the current runtime/environment, with one preregistered rotated observation each. Transform time is worker launch through exit/kill; small deadline cleanup/supervisor overshoot remains charged. Audit and DSEC costs are extra, with nested components not summed twice. Observer overhead is common and retained. Small b03 differences are unresolved at polling/scheduling granularity; no OS-cold or repeated-trial claim.

timing_totals.note: DSEC subcomponents are included in the corresponding driver times; do not add them twice.
